narratives.name: Method Intent
narratives.description: Describes the purpose and scope of the Red Hat Partner Ecosystem Foundations method

narrativeContexts.context: Technology Red Hats like Red Hat depend on partner ecosystems to extend market reach, deliver localized expertise, and accelerate customer adoption. Managing these ecosystems requires structured approaches to partner engagement, capability development, and joint go-to-market execution.

Establish a comprehensive framework that covers the full partner lifecycle from recruitment through renewal, integrating capability enablement, incentive management, and sales play execution through channel partners.

The method decomposes partner ecosystem management into two complementary practices: Partner Engagement and Lifecycle for foundational program architecture and partner development, and Partner Go-to-Market Execution for joint demand generation and deal orchestration through the sales play framework.

A structured, measurable approach to partner ecosystem operations that enables consistent partner experience, predictable pipeline contribution, and scalable go-to-market motions across partner types and engagement models.
